rho_status.note: rho is a point estimate from one cohort, under an exchangeability assumption across cells within a compatibility group that is only approximate (cells differ by phase pair); it is a design diagnostic, not a frozen sizing input

b1_measured_variance_components.sign_free_restriction_note: this runner never reads, computes, prints, or stores a mean, a sign, or a direction of any C43 endpoint -- only variances, as required by the B1 brief

b2_real_panel_ceilings.ceiling_with_25pct_assignment_slack_note: largest N for which the plain lattice is both exactly max-flow feasible AND leaves >=25% margin on the four phase-0/1 module slots' own union -- verified by the exact solver at every candidate N, not derived by scaling the exact ceiling
b2_real_panel_ceilings.rotated_design_withdrawn_reason: the rotated 2x2 lattice purchases M+/M- identification (delta orthogonal to donor and acceptor phase, see delta_balance_report) at a cost of 79 blocks of capacity (726 - 647 = 79), while M+/M- is unpowerable on either lattice at the frozen SESOI regardless (see B3) -- so the rotated design is withdrawn in favour of the plain lattice for sizing purposes

b3_headline: Psi needs 718 blocks against a usable ceiling of ~544 and an absolute ceiling of 726

m_pm_plain_2x2.lower_bound_reason: this lattice has fewer than 3 cells per delta class, so the M_delta variance formula omits the uncancelled donor/acceptor module component -- see A2 / gfmcd.splicing.pbc_v2_capacity.var_direction's docstring; this is a floor, not a calibrated point

b4_cross_lineage_reframe.delta_psi_blocks_needed: not emitted -- the cross-lineage covariance is unknown (see each row's reason); a block count here would be invented
b4_cross_lineage_reframe.primary_endpoint_note: single-checkpoint Psi is NOT the primary endpoint of the downstream study; Delta-Psi = Psi_L2 - Psi_L1 on the same blocks is, and it is paired, so the gene-level component largely cancels for a high enough same-block correlation
b4_cross_lineage_reframe.replicate_caveat: this figure sizes the BLOCK axis only. The replicate for a corpus intervention is the training seed, not the block; a block-clustered interval on Delta-Psi with one L1 and one L2 seed is an interval for that lineage pair, not for the intervention

544.reason: the cross-lineage (same-block L1/L2) covariance must be estimated by a seed-level pilot; it is NOT C43's within-block rho (B1) and is not estimable from anything committed to this record

726.reason: the cross-lineage (same-block L1/L2) covariance must be estimated by a seed-level pilot; it is NOT C43's within-block rho (B1) and is not estimable from anything committed to this record

b4_cross_lineage_reframe.var_psi_note: (2 - rho) * V9 for the plain {0,1} lattice (m=2 matched, u=2 mismatched). NOT C43's raw V9, which is the 3x3 value and would understate the required correlation

b5_filter_relaxation_closed.annotation_disagreement_note: what DOES appear at scale is annotation disagreement BETWEEN SOURCES (comprehensive_coordinate_transcript_phase_conflict, basic_comprehensive_phase_conflict, basic_coordinate_transcript_phase_conflict) -- a GTF-consistency matter, not biology
b5_filter_relaxation_closed.load_bearing_note: each of the three largest sole-reason exclusions is load-bearing for a panel that reads annotated register -- freshness_registry_gene (freshness), module:ValueError:native donor lacks the frozen health-window support (phase-annotation safety), and comprehensive_local_coding_register_conflict (the geometry that makes C43 comparable) -- so none is available to lift supply by relaxing it

upstream_downstream_phase_equal.note: no junction was excluded for donor/acceptor phase inequality; this is DEFINITIONAL (the candidate pool is constructed to require phase equality upstream) and merely UN-CONTRADICTED here, not empirically verified

purpose: memorialize the real-panel capacity finding: the authentic-module design cannot be built at the frozen SESOI, using the real gene pool (not a synthetic one) and measured variance components (not the PBC-v1 development-role upper bound)
study_directory_provisional_note: the study directory name 'splicebert_positional_clock' is PROVISIONAL and may be renamed before anything freezes; unlike the ladder family's development/ artifacts, this one lives at the study root deliberately -- it exists precisely so a later pivot to a different evaluation design cannot silently supersede this finding
